scenarios.passage: Aura Motors Ltd., an established automobile manufacturer in India, is conducting a comprehensive internal strategic review. Immediately liquidate all manufacturing operations
Outsource vehicle design to overseas competitors
linkedMcqs.explanation: To leverage its core competence fully, Aura Motors must address its operational weakness by improving cross-functional coordination and supply chain integration between manufacturing and distribution.
